def average_price(items):
    total_quantity = sum(quantity for quantity, price in items)
    total_cost = sum(quantity * price for quantity, price in items)
    
    if total_quantity == 0:
        return "0.00"  # Handle the case of zero quantity to avoid division by zero.
    
    average = total_cost / total_quantity
    return f"{average:.2f}"
